summary: Introduces Dual-Stack Lite, which helps broadband providers share IPv4 addresses among customers while rolling out IPv6. It combines two familiar techniques, tunneling IPv4 inside IPv6 and network address translation, to better balance the costs and benefits of IPv6 deployment.

eli5.summary: Your home network sends old-style internet traffic through a pipe of the newer kind to the provider, where many homes share a few old addresses. This lets providers go IPv6 without running out of IPv4.

questions: ipv4 address sharing with carrier-grade nat
